description: Target repositories: git repositories outside this folder that an L3 request reads from and promotes into. Put your own values in target.override.json. repos_root: a folder whose subfolders that are git repositories are the targets (named after the folder). repos: name -> {path, base_ref, refused_paths} for a repository elsewhere or settings for a found one. base_ref: the branch files are read from. refused_paths: paths promote never writes in a target (git-style globs).
